items.name: auth-ui
items.title: NocoBase Authentication UI
items.description: Application-owned authentication forms, branding, layout and page composition backed by the authentication plugin.
items.docs: Requires @nocobase/app-plugin-authentication. Installed forms and pages are application-owned, call the plugin's stable headless actions, and override only the plugin route component loaders. Review upgrades with a three-way merge.
